featureName: BOM/Parts Refactoring — Parts as Master Data, BOM as Inventory View
description: Restructure so Parts tab holds all part detail (manufacturer, cost, lead time, etc.) and BOM tab becomes an inventory-focused view showing only: inventory count, qty per unit, classification, and total value. Box sync populates both tables automatically.

userStories.title: Schema migration — Enrich partDefinition + add inventoryCount to bomItem
userStories.description: Add sourcing columns (manufacturer, vendorPartNumber, unitCost, unitOfMeasure, leadTimeDays, minimumOrderQty, hazardClass, certifications, expirationDate, msdsFileId, createdBy) to partDefinition. Add inventoryCount (integer, nullable) to bomItem. Create SQL migration file.
acceptanceCriteria: partDefinition has all sourcing columns in schema.ts
bomItem has inventoryCount column in schema.ts
No existing bomItem columns dropped (soft deprecation)
userStories.notes: Phase 1 — must complete before all other tasks. This terminal (alpha) owns this.

userStories.title: Data migration script — Copy bomItem sourcing data to partDefinition
userStories.description: Create idempotent script that for each bomItem, upserts a partDefinition matched by partNumber. Copies manufacturer, vendorPartNumber, unitCost, etc. Uses transaction, logs summary.
acceptanceCriteria: Idempotent — safe to run multiple times
Logs summary: X created, Y updated, Z skipped
New partDefinitions get scanRequired: false, sortOrder: 0
userStories.notes: Phase 1 — depends on BOMR-01. Alpha terminal.

userStories.title: Update BOM parser — Add inventoryCount field
userStories.description: Add inventoryCount?: number to ParsedBomItem interface. Add COLUMN_ALIASES for inventoryCount. Parse with getNumericValue in parseRow().
acceptanceCriteria: COLUMN_ALIASES includes inventoryCount with aliases: inventory, inventory count, qty on hand, stock, in stock, count, amount current in inventory
userStories.notes: Phase 2 — depends on BOMR-01. Beta terminal.

userStories.title: Update BOM sync — Populate both tables during sync
userStories.description: Modify createBomItem() and updateBomItem() to also insert/update partDefinition with sourcing fields. Write inventoryCount to bomItem. Audit logging covers both tables.
acceptanceCriteria: updateBomItem() also updates partDefinition sourcing fields
inventoryCount written to bomItem during sync
userStories.notes: Phase 2 — depends on BOMR-01 and BOMR-03. Alpha terminal.

userStories.title: Update column mapping UI — Add inventoryCount
userStories.description: Add inventoryCount to mappable fields in settings/mapping page with label 'Inventory Count'.
acceptanceCriteria: inventoryCount included in saveMapping fields list
userStories.notes: Phase 2 — depends on BOMR-03. Beta terminal.

userStories.title: Refactor Parts page — Show full sourcing data
userStories.description: Expand Parts page table to show: Part #, Name, Category, Manufacturer, Unit Cost, Lead Time, Status, Actions. Add stats cards. Expand 'Add Part' modal with sourcing fields. Add View link to detail page.
acceptanceCriteria: Table shows sourcing columns (manufacturer, unitCost, leadTimeDays)
Stats cards: total parts, total categories
Search filters by partNumber, name, manufacturer
'Add Part' modal includes manufacturer, vendorPartNumber, unitCost, unitOfMeasure, leadTimeDays, minimumOrderQty, hazardClass
userStories.notes: Phase 3 — depends on BOMR-01. Gamma terminal.

userStories.title: Refactor BOM page — Inventory-focused view
userStories.description: BOM page joins bomItem with partDefinition on partNumber. Table columns: Part #, Name, Classification, Qty/Unit, Inventory Count, Unit Cost, Total Value. Stats: Total Items, Total Inventory Value, Low Stock. Keep Sync from Box button. Remove manufacturer/vendor PN columns.
acceptanceCriteria: Server load joins bomItem with partDefinition via partNumber
Table shows: partNumber, name, classification, qtyPerUnit, inventoryCount, unitCost, totalValue
Stats: Total Items, Total Inventory Value, Low Stock count
Sync from Box button and status retained
userStories.notes: Phase 3 — depends on BOMR-01. Beta terminal.

userStories.title: Simplify BOM detail page + Remove bomPartLink usage
userStories.description: BOM detail shows inventory count (editable), qty per unit, classification, version history. Sourcing info shown read-only from partDefinition join with link to parts detail. Remove link/unlink part actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory count editable on detail page
Sourcing info read-only from partDefinition join
bomPartLink import/usage removed from active code
Deactivate action and version history retained
userStories.notes: Phase 3 — depends on BOMR-01. Alpha terminal.

userStories.title: Create Parts detail page
userStories.description: New pages at /spu/parts/[partId]. Shows all partDefinition fields with edit form. Side panel shows related BOM data (inventory count, qty per unit) from bomItem join. Toggle active/inactive. Breadcrumb back to parts list.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit form with all partDefinition fields
Side panel shows BOM data from bomItem join
userStories.notes: Phase 3 — depends on BOMR-01. Delta terminal.

userStories.title: Update documentation and run full verification
userStories.description: Update AGENTS.md with new architecture: Parts = master data, BOM = inventory view, partNumber join pattern replacing bomPartLink. Update progress.txt. Run npm run check and npm run lint.
acceptanceCriteria: progress.txt updated with all task completions and learnings
userStories.notes: Phase 4 — depends on all previous tasks. Alpha terminal.
